left.raw_text: 1. have a reported history of neurological condition or disorder including but not limited to brain surgery, special education, seizure disorder, speech pathology, previous diagnosis of Post-Concussion Syndrome (PCS),

right.raw_text: 3. have focal neurologic deficit that would represent risk for walking/running on treadmill,
4. exhibit an inability to exercise due to injury, known heart disease, or increased cardiac risk,
5. have experienced more than 3 previous concussions,

left.raw_text: 6. have suffered a substantial comorbidity (eg,cervical injury),
7. currently taking β-blockers, calcium channel blockers, or prophylactic headache medications (e.g., amitriptyline, topiramate),

right.raw_text: or 8. have a resting blood pressure of > 140/90.
